confirmatory_window.overlap_rule: the v4 confirmatory window opens inside the open v3 confirmatory window in time; the two evaluations share no asset, because the v4 candidate set is disjoint from the v1, v2 and v3 candidate sets, and the v4 evaluation may only start after the v3 confirmatory gate clears (BRAIN-013 phase gates)

data_boundary.access_counting: Every read of a candle inside a confirmatory window increments holdout_exposed_count in the checkpoint of that version and is recorded in its holdout report.
data_boundary.development_cutoff_rule: configs/research_v4.json#holdout.development_cutoff_utc: any development data read at or after the v3 confirmatory-window open is inside that window, so the v4 development data ends at the cutoff: the last development candle is the one that closes exactly at the cutoff, and no candle that closes after the cutoff may be read
data_boundary.development_data_rule: Candles that close at or before effective_data_boundary_utc are development data and may inform selection. No candle that closes after that instant may be read during selection.
data_boundary.effective_data_boundary_rule: the earlier of the v4 confirmatory-window start and the preregistered development cutoff; the v4 confirmatory window opens inside the open v3 confirmatory window, so the development cutoff is the binding boundary
data_boundary.min_confirmatory_window_rationale: 90 days of closed hourly candles; the v1 protocol used a 0.2 holdout fraction of a multi-year window, which is of the same order.
data_boundary.v4_confirmatory_window_start_rule: the first UTC hour boundary strictly after candidate_freeze_utc
